coordinate_convention: IAU2000 planetocentric latitude, east longitude in degrees
footprint_model: point sampling only; no shot-footprint averaging or instrumental error model
interpolation: bilinear Earth DEM sampling followed by linear TIN; no extrapolation; nearest-point distance capped at 1000 m
quality_rule: retain A=0 only where attitude exists; original PEDR shot good/bad bit unavailable in ODE CSV, retain unknown shot quality and label it
earth_source: Existing NASADEM projected fields at 125 m; centered 80 km support diagnostic, not new independent DEM observations
